description: This file is the main entry point for a React-based frontend application. It initializes the React application by rendering the root component `<App />` into the DOM element with ID 'root', utilizing ReactDOM's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root container for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the specified DOM node.
